name: Night in Delirium
source:
In the lonely wasteland that leads to a mining site, someone dumps the body of a woman and a series of horrible clues with the cryptic message of her killer at night. Who is hiding to commit such atrocities and why? 

Nicolas, the young owner of Bar Delirio, has decided to discover the murderer to protect the life of the only family he has left: his little niece. But he won't be alone. If he trusts the right person, he might find more than just the truth. Maybe he will end up discovering his true desires in the Delirium.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3352560/Night_in_Delirium/?curator_clanid=4777282]Steam[/url]]
translation:
在通向采矿场的偏僻荒地上，有人在夜间倾倒了一具妇女的尸体和一系列可怕的线索，其中包含凶手的神秘信息。是谁躲藏起来犯下如此暴行，为什么？

尼古拉斯是酒吧Delirio的年轻老板，他决定找出凶手，以保护他仅存的家人：他的小侄女的生命。但他不会孤单。如果他信任正确的人，他可能会发现的不仅仅是真相。也许他最终会在谵妄中发现自己真正的愿望。

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3352560/Night_in_Delirium/?curator_clanid=4777282]Steam[/url]]
